The weighted port throughput calculation succeeded with a perfect reward score, validating the core logic and integration.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the legacy pytest suite in test_output.py without exceptions. The harbor job results confirmed 1/1 trials passed with a mean score of 1.000 over a 3m 54s runtime. While successful, future iterations should re-check edge cases in weight distribution to ensure the calculation remains robust against zero-value inputs.
